promptAsSent:
Use the image_gen tool to generate exactly one image, then stop. Do not write files, run commands or edit anything.

Attached reference images, in order:
Image 1: Base design authority: the finished armory image of the suit this pattern varies; design, palette, composition and finish
Image 2: Identity: the same suit seen from directly overhead in battle; palette and silhouette character

Use case: style-matched variant of an existing product render. Asset: the armory catalogue image of one marine armour suit, for a gritty military dark-science-fiction tactical game in the Starsector setting.

Image 1 is the finished armory image of the base suit this pattern belongs to: it is the authority for the design, palette, plate shapes, markings, composition, camera, lighting and realistic hand-painted finish. Produce a variant of this same suit that a player recognises at once as a sibling of Image 1, changing only what is described below and keeping everything else as Image 1 has it.

Image 2 shows how this suit is drawn in battle, from directly overhead (left: the torso and shoulder plates; right: the helmet top). The variant must still match it in palette and silhouette character. Never show the overhead view itself.

Packframe support harness: an unpowered cargo frame with its load arms cut short and a launch rail welded where a crate used to sit. Keep the outlaw brick-red, rust and soot palette on its few plates, and make the defining piece a rugged tubular backpack frame with two stubby cut-down load arms and a short steel launch rail welded across its top carrying one olive rocket with a yellow-and-black hazard band. The frame stands upright behind the vest. Independent crew work: bolts, welds, no powered parts.

Square 1:1 canvas with every piece fully inside the frame and a clear margin. True transparent background, including the gaps between pieces; no ground, no cast-shadow slab, no border, no text, letters, numbers, logos or watermark, no person or face inside the suit, no weapon held or worn except an item named above.
